trait_descs: ["Face up: gain 1 Ready. Ready: while Sword is face up, after an ally spell resolves, deal 4 damage to the front enemy, then consume Ready."]
["When thrown, give 2 shield to the front ally."]
["When thrown, give 1 Speedup to the front ally."]
["When thrown, apply 1 Lockout to self and the enemy face-up equipment. Lockout: throw and face-up effects are disabled, cannot stack, and is consumed after spell resolution."]
["Ammo 1. Face up or ally action: consume ammo to deal 4. Face up while empty: reload 1."]
["Face up: gain 1 charge up to 3. Reset after ally action or losing face up."]
["While face up, every 3 countdown ticks, give 1 Speedup to the front ally."]
["While face up, the holder's spell and trait healing is increased by 2."]
